statement: The input is a Python 3 function that is meant to return the largest sum of any prefix of xs, where the empty prefix counts and has sum 0 (so the result is never negative). It contains exactly one bug: an off-by-one, a wrong operator, or a wrong initial value. Fix the bug, then evaluate the corrected function for the call `max_prefix_sum([-24, 12, -19, -7, -9, -16, -1, 24, -26, -7, 23, -1])`. Answer with the integer it returns.
title: Blue belt: fix max_prefix_sum
